title: Finance Analyst
description:
Chalk Hill Group are partnering with an established organisation, based in Bournemouth, in their search for a Finance Analyst to join their Finance team on a permanent basis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the mapping and reconciliation of their ERP system, ensuring data accuracy across multiple entities.
  • Assist with system configuration, maintenance, testing and data modelling.
  • Help automate reporting processes and build structures to support the preparation of consolidated group accounts and financial statement notes.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and work closely with internal stakeholders to deliver enhancements.
  • Contribute to wider finance transformation projects, ensuring deadlines are met and improvements are delivered effectively.

About You

  • Ideally someone studying ACCA or CIMA
  • Strong financial systems experience, alongside advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with financial reporting, including financial statements and notes to the accounts.
  • Familiarity with financial consolidation or planning tools
  • A proactive problem-solver who can manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and communicate confidently with stakeholders across the business.

Hybrid working with only occasional visits to the office required.

Chalk Hill Group is a Recruitment Agency. By applying for this role, you are authorising us as a Recruitment Agency to contact you and to provide services and information relating to job hunting activities. Please see our Privacy Policy on our website.
